oneLiner: Bounties for catching what changed in the fine print. GenLayer validators decide if it matters.
description: Fine Print is a StudioNet policy-watch bounty app with five deployed contracts. Wayback baselines and later passages feed validator judgments; code controls bonds, deadlines, refunds and verified native payouts. Actual scripted outcomes: baseline passage: CODE_REJECTED; date-only: TRIGGERED; injection: TRIGGERED, challenge REJECTED; prior substance: VOID, challenge UPHELD; genuine change: TRIGGERED, challenge REJECTED. Original timing failures remain recorded; recovery IDs are labeled. The date-only TRIGGERED result is a compiler false positive. Funded current watches show archive timestamps and expiries. Public receipts retain actual outcomes; the contracts were not edited or redeployed.

howTo.heading: Read the Change Ledger
howTo.instruction: Browse the recorded case journal and finalized ledger without a wallet. Compare archived passages, criteria, actual verdicts and challenge rulings. The date-only result is flagged as an observed false positive; original timeout and VOID paths remain visible. Follow each case receipt and direct StudioNet contract link.

howTo.heading: Review open watches
howTo.instruction: Open the watch docket to see current production policies, frozen criteria, baseline snapshot, funded bounty and expiry. Historical replays are labeled and do not appear as open production watches.

howTo.heading: Start a watch
howTo.instruction: Connect a StudioNet wallet, enter a canonical policy URL and a checkable concern, then review the validator-compiled criteria and pinned Wayback baseline. Confirm the bounty and expiry before signing the value transfer.

howTo.heading: Submit or challenge a claim
howTo.instruction: For a claim, provide a later id_ snapshot and a passage up to 1,200 characters. Code first checks the exact CDX row and passage presence and absence. For a challenge, choose ALREADY_EXISTED or WRONG_DOCUMENT and provide the matching archived evidence.

howTo.heading: Follow finality and settlement
howTo.instruction: Use the transaction log to follow submitted, pending, accepted and finalized states. Open a case to see the appeal and challenge deadlines, the final ruling, the payout receipt and the contract state readback.

expectedOutcome: Actual execution and receipts are published, including unexpected verdicts and original timing failures. 3 current watches are funded. Contract deposits total 848 wei under the owner's 1,110-wei cap. The cosmetic compiler false positive remains an explicit product limitation; no contract was edited or redeployed to hide it.
